description: This file contains handlers for speech-to-text (STT) WebView messages, including starting, stopping, listing devices, selecting devices, and checking availability. It manages STT services per provider, handles message passing, and includes a class for capturing visible code for context.

classes.name: VisibleCodeGlossary
classes.description: Captures visible code and formats it into a glossary prompt, used during recording sessions.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an STTService instance for a given ClineProvider.

methods.name: handleSTTStart
methods.description: Starts the STT service with optional language parameter, handling API key retrieval and error cases.

methods.name: handleSTTListDevices
methods.description: Lists available microphone devices and sends to WebView.

methods.name: handleSTTSelectDevice
methods.description: Selects a microphone device for the STT service and updates state.

methods.name: handleSTTCheckAvailability
methods.description: Checks if speech-to-text is available and reports status.

methods.name: handleSTTCommand
methods.description: Dispatches STT commands to appropriate handler functions.

methods.name: getGlossary
methods.description: Captures visible code and formats it as a glossary prompt.
